mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (sender_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, content, image_paths) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverType}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{imagePaths})
mapper.select: SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, content, image_paths, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_type = 'PRIVATE' AND ( (sender_id = #{userA} AND receiver_id = #{userB}) OR (sender_id = #{userB} AND receiver_id = #{userA}) ) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
